item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM`, wraps a real `dspy.Predict` with `wrap_program`, and calls the wrapped function on a real `Example`, matching the SIMBA wrapper entrypoint."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Defines a custom metric that returns `dspy.Prediction` with numeric `score` plus auxiliary fields, which is exactly the contract `wrap_program` handles."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Runs the wrapped callable, prints `score` and `output_metadata`, and asserts `output_metadata` contains the auxiliary fields exactly while excluding `score`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Explicitly checks `out[\"prediction\"].answer == \"2\"`, confirming the wrapped result preserves the original program prediction."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Keeps aggregate reward in `score` and separate subscores/feedback in `output_metadata`, matching SIMBA's downstream reward-value versus reward-info split."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
